title: Clean Classic Netherrack
description: Cleaner version of the old Netherrack texture.
body:
# **Clean Classic Netherrack**
This pack changes the original Netherrack texture to make it less noisy, and this extends to all blocks that incorporate the netherrack texture as a base. (Quartz ore, Nether gold ore, Nylium).
![Comparison between default and pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02aa8317ef08d54799a488a341fa47f721d5edd4.png)

## Other packs:
If you're looking for a pack that has the whole Nether retextured in the old style, check out [Classic Modern Nether](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/classic-modern-nether)!

If you're looking for more updated old textures, or new textures retextured to fit in with the old ones, check out my other pack, [Programmer Art Updated](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/programmer-art-updated)!

### **Make sure that this pack is above the rest in the pack list**
![Pack order](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e00a192e04725ebef389515e431680ab13875d4c.png)
